| Coordinate | Value | Status |
|---|---|---|
| GEN | Offspring of Yaldabaoth | Attested |

| ADR — heaven | Seventh | Attested (*Origin*) |
| ADR — chromatic index | 8 (anchored at F=1) | Computed; not a cosmological claim |
| ADR — fifth index | 2 (anchored at F=1) | Computed; not a cosmological claim |
| FUNC | New governing authority | Attested |

Five different address coordinates, none of which implies the others. The chromatic index of 8 does not place Sabaoth among the abyssal five; that would require a rule mapping chromatic positions 8–12 to abyssal authorities, which no source in the corpus supplies.
